description:
Perform an image performance and Core Web Vitals audit on https://crawler-test.com/. 

1. Crawl the website using Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Identify images that cause Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) by filtering for 'Missing Size Attributes' in the Images tab.
3. Export these CLS-risk images to a CSV file named 'missing_dimensions.csv' in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
4. Identify heavy images (Over 100kb) that impact load time. If the standard 'Over 100kb' filter yields no results, sort by size and identify the largest images (>50kb).
5. Export these heavy images to a CSV file named 'heavy_images.csv' in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
6. Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/image_optimization_report.txt' summarizing the counts of issues found and recommending fixes (e.g., adding width/height attributes).
